title: Roveia stacked case studies (v2)
description: Window-tall rounded video cards that stick near the top one after another, each new card sliding up over the last while it grows from 90% to full size. A dark wash deepens towards the foot, where a 40px client name and a short story sit; over a card a blue pill with an arrow follows the cursor.
notes: desktop cards are sized by the window (calc(100svh − 2rem)); phones get 400px cards that stack the same way
cards wrap themselves in .dark; the media slot takes a video or picture (object-fit: cover)
the cursor-following pill needs JavaScript (hydrate: visible); without it the pill sits in the centre on hover
name: roveia-v2-cases
